# ESC/P Command Reference — not applicable to PT-E920BT

Brother lists **Raster** and **Mobile SDK** as the PT-E920BT printer languages; ESC/P is
not advertised for this model.

## Sources

- [Brother PT-E920BT product page](https://brothermobilesolutions.com/products/printers/p-touch/pt-portable/pte920bt/) — printer languages: Raster, Mobile SDK
- [Brother command reference model list](https://support.brother.com/g/s/es/dev/en/command/reference/index.html) — PT-E920BT is not listed

## Related family reference (not committed as text)

Brother publishes an ESC/P Command Reference for the 360 dpi PT-P900 family
(PT-P900/P900W/P950NW). Provenance and fetch instructions are in [INDEX.md](INDEX.md)
under *ESC/P Command Reference (PT-P900 family — not applicable)*.

This project targets direct USB raster printing (issue #5); ESC/P is out of scope for v0.1.
